messages:
Lina (CS): heads up — large customer (localization team) flagged a regression after yesterday's rollout. their Indonesian and Polish translation pipelines are returning English instead of target language for ~15% of short prompts. they saw it after 2026-03-16 18:40 UTC rollout of redwood-translate-v2.3 :frowning:

Miguel (Eng): thanks Lina. any sample inputs + outputs from the customer?

Lina (CS): yes, pasted below (customer sanitized):

Input: "`translate to Indonesian: 'How long will the delivery take?'`"
Output (expected): "`Berapa lama pengirimannya akan tiba?`"
Output (actual): "`How long will the delivery take?`"

Input: "`Polish: 'Where is the nearest train station?'`"
Expected: "`Gdzie jest najbliższa stacja kolejowa?`"
Actual: "`Where is the nearest train station?`"

Lina (CS): they say it started immediately after the v2.3 rollout, and repro rate spikes for short prompts (<10 tokens). longer sentences are fine.

Thomas (ML): :eyes: that pattern (short prompt fallback to English) could be a tokenization or prefix-detection issue. did the rollout include any new tokenizer/vocab changes or fallback policies? which quantization/variant was pushed?

Miguel (Eng): rollout notes: redwood-translate-v2.3 (commit c3f9a) — changed attention kernel and added a fast-prefix-cache optimization. no tokenizer change. default serving variant is `v2.3-quant8` in us-west. will pull the rollout logs.

Ava (SRE): deploy-bot shows canary -> 100% completed at 2026-03-16T18:40:12Z. I have the per-request trace IDs from the customer, Lina can you share them? we can correlate with per-node kernel selection.

Lina (CS): shared trace ids via DM. customer also provided a short curl repro: 

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-translate-v2.3","input":"Polish: 'Where is the nearest train station?'","max_tokens":40}'
```

Miguel (Eng): I'll run that against prod and a pinned v2.2 instance. also checking if prefix-cache returns English fallback when prefix length < 3 tokens.

Thomas (ML): please also log the chosen kernel and tokenization output (token ids). if token ids map to english-only tokens due to an off-by-one, that would explain exact-copy fallback. hypothesizing: prefix cache key collision between locales causing model to return cached english completion.

Ava (SRE): I see higher-than-normal prefix-cache hitrate on v2.3 canaries for short sequences. metrics dashboard: cache_hit_rate_short_prompts jumped from 2% -> 28% after rollout. i'll temporarily disable fast-prefix-cache on a subset and report.

Lina (CS): customer would prefer fix ASAP. suggested mitigation — pin to `redwood-translate-v2.2` or set `cache_mode:off` in request until we have a fix. they asked for exact instructions we can paste.

Miguel (Eng): mitigation curl for customer: 

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-translate-v2.3","input":"Polish: 'Where is the nearest train station?'","max_tokens":40,"cache_mode":"off"}'
```

Miguel (Eng): i'll open an internal rollback flag for v2.3 canaries while Thomas checks cache key computation. if disabling the prefix cache resolves repro, we'll hotfix the cache key namespace to include locale hint.

Thomas (ML): starting repro now. logging tokenization and kv-cache keys. initial quick check: when input starts with single-word locale token ("Polish:"), tokenizer sometimes attaches a space token differently which can produce an empty locale token in the cache key. probable race between tokenizer normalization and cache key hashing.

Ava (SRE): created incident ticket INF-2026-471 and linked traces. rolling back fast-prefix-cache for 25% of traffic in us-west. will monitor error/latency/correctness signals.

Lina (CS): passed mitigations to the customer (pin to v2.2 / cache_mode off). they replied :thumbsup: and will confirm if repro stops. will update thread when they confirm.

Miguel (Eng): action items: (1) Thomas to root-cause cache key mismatch and propose fix (2) If confirmed, release patch to include locale in cache key and add unit tests (3) if necessary, revert v2.3 fast-prefix-cache rollout. ETA: initial RCA in 4 hours.

Thomas (ML): noted. will post token diffs and a minimal failing unit test here when ready.

Lina (CS): thanks team — keeping this open until customer confirms resolution"
